key_insight: VISTA Architect precomputes a provenance-linked clinical knowledge graph and a concise patient timeline so LLMs can answer longitudinal EHR questions faster and more accurately than repeated raw-text prompting or RAG.
clinical_relevance: For tumor boards, it helps reconstruct complex patient histories with high fidelity, supporting faster case preparation and more reliable access to source documentation when verification is needed.
method: Builds a source-faithful MEDS Graph that preserves granular EHR structure and provenance.
Uses a graph-guided LLM to create a deduplicated, temporally coherent Timeline Object Architecture (TOA).
Lets downstream queries traverse from summarized patient state back to original records for detail checks.
evidence_signal: In 1,180 thoracic oncology patients, it reached 96.4% accuracy (mean 9.75/10) across 17,700 evaluations on 15 tumor-board-salient variables, outperforming a matched BM25 RAG baseline.
watch_item: The system was demonstrated in thoracic oncology, so broader performance and workflow fit in other specialties still need validation.
paper_title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
